item.title: Federal court ruling helps Wisconsin preserve $62M in federal EV funding
item.description: Wisconsin Attorney General Josh Kaul announced that a multi-state coalition secured a victory against the administration’s efforts to block billions of dollars in funds for electric vehicle charging stations. The post Federal court ruling helps Wisconsin preserve $62M in federal EV funding appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Door County bakery Cultured named a semi-finalist for James Beard Award
item.description: In May 2023, baker Mattea Fischer opened a permanent, physical location for her bakery Cultured after years of selling at farmers’ markets and working out of other kitchens. Less than three years later, Cultured has been nominated as a semi-finalist for a national James Beard award. The post Door County bakery Cultured named a semi-finalist for James Beard Award appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Sandhill cranes as game: Debate over hunt intensifies
item.description: A sandhill crane hunt is perhaps closer than ever to becoming a reality in Wisconsin. Two experts with two different perspectives expressed their hopes and concerns on a recent episode of "The Larry Meiller Show." The post Sandhill cranes as game: Debate over hunt intensifies appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Wisconsinites join Day of Action protesting ICE
item.description: Supporters have been calling for "no school, no work, no shopping," as they urge participants to call out of work or school and to refrain from spending money. The post Wisconsinites join Day of Action protesting ICE appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Wisconsin service industry workers see benefits of federal ‘no tax on tips’ policy
item.description: Changes to federal and state income tax policies could make service industry careers easier to sustain. The post Wisconsin service industry workers see benefits of federal ‘no tax on tips’ policy appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Nicotine pouches may help smokers quit, but pose addictive risks for young people
item.description: Pouches are the fastest growing nicotine product on the market in America. Studies show that while they may help addicted people lower risk, they're also a potential gateway for young people. The post Nicotine pouches may help smokers quit, but pose addictive risks for young people appeared first on WPR.

item.description: Democratic Sen. Tammy Baldwin believes immigration enforcement and border patrol agencies have gone "rogue" and she is calling for greater oversight and accountability. item.title: Shorewood trespassing citation could decide future of beach access in Wisconsin
item.description: A Shorewood man is planning to appeal a municipal judge's decision that found him guilty of trespassing in hopes that the case will go to the Wisconsin Supreme Court and decide public versus private beach access in the state. The post Shorewood trespassing citation could decide future of beach access in Wisconsin appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Trump’s trade war took a toll on shipments in the Twin Ports last year
item.description: Cargo shipments at the Port of Duluth-Superior slumped last year due to headwinds driven by unfavorable market trends, shifting trade lanes and President Donald Trump’s trade war. The post Trump’s trade war took a toll on shipments in the Twin Ports last year appeared first on WPR.

item.title: Lapse of health care contract for Milwaukee County employees angers officials
item.description: Milwaukee County officials are calling for an "emergency action" after learning that the contract covering healthcare for thousands of county employees has lapsed. The post Lapse of health care contract for Milwaukee County employees angers officials appeared first on WPR.
